## Objective

Build an exact candidate from the reconciled baseline and capture full source/provider identity. Run architecture, symbol ownership, JVM/Scala.js and relevant existing-consumer gates. Inventory any preexisting failures with owners before claiming an admitted baseline.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 2, 14, FA-00. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `baseline qualification receipt`
- `existing focused and aggregate suites`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Record candidate SHA or exact patch hashes and all provider SHAs, commands and exit states.
2. Baseline gates pass, or required repairs are linked as actual prerequisites before closure.
3. Record same-environment transform/resampling performance baselines for AC-050; no unrun remote or release claim.

## Blocking prerequisites

- B01: FA-B01: Reconcile the existing architecture and build DAG
- B02: FA-B02: Align ownership CI inputs and settle toolchain/provider admission

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-B03: Qualify the isolated baseline and unaffected consumer gates
